description: This file defines React components for displaying individual product cards and a grid of products in a furniture marketplace frontend. It includes TypeScript types, imports external hooks and components, and contains JSX for rendering UI elements.

methods.name: ProductCard
methods.description: React functional component that displays a product card with image, title, price, and 'Add to Cart' button.

methods.name: ProductGrid
methods.description: React functional component that renders a grid layout of multiple ProductCard components.
